## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

setwd("C:/Users/aay6/Desktop/Blepharisma_Warming/Bleph_warming_Oct_2023_FlowCytometer/All_data")

#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(data.table)
library(MASS)

dir.create("models", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Full flow-cytometry dataset
full_data_file <- "All_Flowcytometer.csv"

# Flow-cytometry files containing manually gated reference algae events
gate_files <- c(
  "FW8Red_Sample77.csv",
  "FW5Red_Sample50.csv",
  "FW8Black_Sample235.csv",
  "FW8Red_Sample76.csv",
  "Nov1_235_Algae.csv"
)
```

Reference algal events were obtained by manually gating representative flow-cytometry samples using the flow cytometer software. These manually identified events were pooled and used to define the multivariate fluorescence distribution of algae, which was then applied consistently across the complete dataset.

## Identify Algal Events

```{r}
#| label: identify-algae

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load manually gated reference algae events
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

algae_gate <- data.table::rbindlist(
  lapply(gate_files, data.table::fread),
  fill = TRUE
)

# Standardize column names
data.table::setnames(
  algae_gate,
  gsub("-", "_", names(algae_gate))
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load complete flow-cytometry dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

full_data <- data.table::fread(full_data_file)

# Standardize column names
data.table::setnames(
  full_data,
  gsub("-", "_", names(full_data))
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify events with valid fluorescence values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

valid_fluorescence <-
  !is.na(full_data$FITC_H) &
  !is.na(full_data$PerCP_H) &
  full_data$FITC_H > 0 &
  full_data$PerCP_H > 0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define algae reference distribution
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Log-transform manually gated reference algae events
algae_gate_t <- data.table::copy(algae_gate)

algae_gate_t[, `:=`(
  FITC_H = log10(FITC_H),
  PerCP_H = log10(PerCP_H)
)]


# Estimate robust center and covariance of reference algae events
robust_cov <- MASS::cov.trob(
  as.matrix(algae_gate_t[, .(FITC_H, PerCP_H)])
)

center <- robust_cov$center
covmat <- robust_cov$cov


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Classify algae events in complete dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Initialize all events as outside the algae classification
full_data$inside_algae_gate <- FALSE
full_data$mahalanobis <- NA_real_


# Log-transform valid events
X <- cbind(
  FITC_H = log10(full_data$FITC_H[valid_fluorescence]),
  PerCP_H = log10(full_data$PerCP_H[valid_fluorescence])
)


# Calculate Mahalanobis distance
md <- mahalanobis(
  X,
  center = center,
  cov = covmat
)


# 99% chi-square cutoff for two fluorescence dimensions
cutoff <- qchisq(
  0.99,
  df = 2
)


# Classify events
full_data$mahalanobis[valid_fluorescence] <- md

full_data$inside_algae_gate[valid_fluorescence] <-
  md <= cutoff


# Retain events classified as algae
algae <- full_data %>%
  filter(inside_algae_gate)

```

## Calculate Algae Abundance

```{r}
#| label: calculate-algae-abundance

# Assign experimental treatments
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    Algae_Presence = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW2", "FW3", "FW4") ~ "No",
      FW %in% c("FW5", "FW6", "FW7", "FW8") ~ "Yes"
    ),

    number_of_predators = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW5") ~ "2",
      FW %in% c("FW2", "FW3", "FW6", "FW7") ~ "1",
      FW %in% c("FW4", "FW8") ~ "0"
    ),

    ID_of_predators = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW5") ~ "Both",
      FW %in% c("FW3", "FW7") ~ "Blepharisma",
      FW %in% c("FW2", "FW6") ~ "Euplotes",
      FW %in% c("FW4", "FW8") ~ "None"
    )
  )


# Calculate algae abundance in treatments where algae were experimentally added
abundance_df <- full_data %>%
  filter(Algae_Presence == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(
    Jar,
    Day,
    FW,
    Temperature,
    number_of_predators,
    ID_of_predators
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(inside_algae_gate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate algae abundance for treatments where algae were experimentally added
abundance_df <- algae %>%
  filter(Algae_Presence == "Yes") %>%
  count(
    Jar,
    Day,
    FW,
    Temperature,
    number_of_predators,
    ID_of_predators,
    name = "abundance"
  )


# Format variables for statistical analysis
abundance_df <- abundance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Jar = factor(Jar),

    Day = as.numeric(Day),

    Temperature = factor(
      Temperature,
      levels = c("Stable", "Warming", "Recovery")
    ),

    number_of_predators = factor(
      number_of_predators,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2")
    ),

    ID_of_predators = factor(
      ID_of_predators,
      levels = c("None", "Blepharisma", "Euplotes", "Both")
    )
  )
```

## Base Model

With `Temperature * Day`, you’re fitting:

-   **Intercept** → baseline abundance

-   **Day slope** → overall temporal trend

-   **Temperature effects** → differences at Day = 0 (interpret carefully)

-   **Interaction terms** → how slopes differ by temperature

So biologically:

“Do warming/recovery change the *rate* of algae increase/decrease over time?”

## Algae Abundance Base Model

Algal abundance was modeled using a negative binomial mixed-effects model to account for overdispersion in the count data. Jar was included as a random intercept to account for repeated measurements through time.

```{r}

fit_algae_base <- brms::brm(
  abundance ~ Temperature * Day + (1 | Jar),
  data = abundance_df,
  family = brms::negbinomial(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_algae_base,
  "models/fit_algae_base.rds"
)
```

## Predator ID

```{r}
## Algae Abundance: Predator Identity

fit_algae_id <- brms::brm(
  abundance ~ Temperature * Day * ID_of_predators + (1 | Jar),
  data = abundance_df,
  family = brms::negbinomial(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_algae_id,
  "models/fit_algae_id.rds"
)
```

## Predator Richness

```{r}
## Algae Abundance: Predator Richness

fit_algae_rich <- brms::brm(
  abundance ~ Temperature * Day * number_of_predators + (1 | Jar),
  data = abundance_df,
  family = brms::negbinomial(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_algae_rich,
  "models/fit_algae_rich.rds"
)
```
